# CLI

由 `python -m forge --help`、各子命令 `--help`、`python -m overlay --help` 生成。
W1/W2 合入后由集成者重跑 `python3 scripts/gen_cli_docs.py`。
人手不要在 README / skill / 设计文档里抄子命令清单。

## python -m forge

```text
usage: python -m forge [-h]
                       {apply,status,check,submit,pr-title,title,sop-lock,ci-select,ops-review,promote,bounce,release}
                       ...

Forge: 开发侧 check + submit (代推 draft PR); Ops apply/status (Ruleset); Ops
release (product tags). Does not merge. Does not write CODEOWNERS, AGENTS.md,
or workflows.

positional arguments:
  {apply,status,check,submit,pr-title,title,sop-lock,ci-select,ops-review,promote,bounce,release}
    apply               create or update forge-protected-<branch> and forge-
                        protected-tags
    status              read-only: installed / missing / drifted per ruleset
    check               local pre-submit gate. Exit 0/2. No GitHub write.
                        submit refuses if this is red.
    submit              开发侧代推: run forge check, then push the feature branch
                        and open/update a draft PR. Never merges.
    pr-title (title)    lint a GitHub PR title (Conventional Commits +
                        product/actor). Exit 0/2. No GitHub write.
    sop-lock            decidable SOP locks (workflows, kernel, skills Lock,
                        required_checks). Exit 0/2.
    ci-select           decide whether a CI check runs (common always; product
                        via forge.yaml). Exit 0/3.
    ops-review          Overlay Ops: observe CodeRabbit/Copilot comments
                        (advisory). Never a merge gate.
    promote             open or update a promote PR (from → to). Never merges.
                        Needs FORGE_SUBMIT_TOKEN.
    bounce              Overlay Ops: 打回 PR + write ops-debug.yaml. Never
                        merges.
    release             Ops: publish overlay-v* and/or forge-v* GitHub
                        Releases. Not production CD. Never merges.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
```

## python -m forge apply

```text
usage: python -m forge apply [-h] --repo REPO [--path PATH] [--dry-run]

options:
  -h, --help   show this help message and exit
  --repo REPO  OWNER/NAME
  --path PATH  forge.yaml (optional; defaults protect=main)
  --dry-run    print all ruleset payloads and exit 0 without writing
```

## python -m forge status

```text
usage: python -m forge status [-h] --repo REPO [--root ROOT] [--path PATH]
                              [--write WRITE] [--check-state]

options:
  -h, --help     show this help message and exit
  --repo REPO    OWNER/NAME
  --root ROOT    repo root (default: .)
  --path PATH    forge.yaml (optional)
  --write WRITE  write a generated Chinese status page (e.g. docs/STATE.md)
  --check-state  fail if docs/STATE.md is missing or stale vs forge.yaml + git
```

## python -m forge check

```text
usage: python -m forge check [-h] [--root ROOT] [--title TITLE] [--body BODY]

options:
  -h, --help     show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT    repo root (default: .)
  --title TITLE  PR title to lint (same as pr-title). Default: env PR_TITLE.
                 Local omit skips. pull_request + blank fails. push lints HEAD
                 commit.
  --body BODY    PR body to lint when docs/pr-brief.md exists. Default: env
                 PR_BODY. Local omit skips. pull_request + blank fails the six
                 headings.
```

## python -m forge submit

```text
usage: python -m forge submit [-h] --repo REPO [--title TITLE] [--path PATH]
                              [--head HEAD] [--base BASE] [--dry-run]

options:
  -h, --help     show this help message and exit
  --repo REPO    OWNER/NAME
  --title TITLE  PR title. Must pass python -m forge pr-title.
  --path PATH    forge.yaml (optional; defaults protect=main)
  --head HEAD    Feature branch to submit. Default: current HEAD, else
                 GITHUB_HEAD_REF.
  --base BASE    PR base. Default: protect[0]. Must be a protect branch.
  --dry-run      print intended remote branch + PR title/body headings; no
                 push. Still requires FORGE_SUBMIT_TOKEN (fail-closed if
                 missing). Red if check is red.
```

## python -m forge pr-title

```text
usage: python -m forge pr-title [-h] [--title TITLE] [--body BODY]
                                [--event EVENT] [--root ROOT]

options:
  -h, --help     show this help message and exit
  --title TITLE  PR title, e.g. "feat(overlay/dev): add cover triad". Default:
                 env PR_TITLE. Local omit skips. pull_request + blank fails.
                 push lints HEAD commit.
  --body BODY    PR body. Default: env PR_BODY. Local omit skips. pull_request
                 + blank fails six 解说规格 headings when docs/pr-brief.md exists.
  --event EVENT  GitHub event JSON path (reads pull_request.title /
                 pull_request.body).
  --root ROOT    Repo root used to detect docs/pr-brief.md (default: .).
```

## python -m forge ci-select

```text
usage: python -m forge ci-select [-h] [--root ROOT] --check CHECK
                                 [--title TITLE] [--changed [CHANGED ...]]
                                 [--github-output]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT           repo root (default: .)
  --check CHECK         check name: pr-title, sop-lock, overlay-check, or
                        forge-check
  --title TITLE         PR title. Default: env PR_TITLE. Title product facet
                        wins when valid.
  --changed [CHANGED ...]
                        Changed paths when no valid title (push). Omit to use
                        git HEAD~1.
  --github-output       append run=true|false to $GITHUB_OUTPUT (skip is
                        success)
```

## python -m forge release

```text
usage: python -m forge release [-h] --repo REPO --version VERSION
                               [--products PRODUCTS] [--sha SHA] [--root ROOT]
                               [--dry-run]

options:
  -h, --help           show this help message and exit
  --repo REPO          OWNER/NAME
  --version VERSION    semver without prefix, e.g. 1.0.1
  --products PRODUCTS  both (default), overlay, or forge
  --sha SHA            commit to tag. Default: origin/main via API (or
                       GITHUB_SHA).
  --root ROOT          workshop root for __version__ check
  --dry-run            print the two release payloads; no GitHub write. No
                       token required.
```

## python -m overlay

```text
usage: python -m overlay [-h] {validate,select,review,run,cover,migrate} ...

Overlay: validate inbox/suites, select active suites, run their
product_command, report cover, migrate v1 suites. No generate. No model on
this path.

positional arguments:
  {validate,select,review,run,cover,migrate}
    validate            validate inbox + suites + overlay.yaml
    select              print active suite ids for a branch
    review              human review (refuses without --i-am; no writes yet)
    run                 select active suites and run product_command
    cover               print function_id triad + invariant coverage
    migrate             rewrite suite.yaml draft/armed to overlay-suite/v2

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
```

## python -m overlay run

```text
usage: python -m overlay run [-h] [--branch BRANCH] [--root ROOT]
                             --write-receipt DIR [--workdir WORKDIR]
                             [--timeout TIMEOUT]

options:
  -h, --help           show this help message and exit
  --branch BRANCH      branch name from overlay.yaml (default:
                       GITHUB_BASE_REF, then GITHUB_REF_NAME, then main)
  --root ROOT          adopter overlay root (default: .)
  --write-receipt DIR  directory for a program-written receipt (wrote_by=run);
                       required
  --workdir WORKDIR    directory to run product_command in (caller checkout;
                       no foreign clone)
  --timeout TIMEOUT    seconds per command (default 600)
```
